name: Matsui Construction Co., Ltd.
summary: Matsui Construction Co., Ltd. engages in the design, supervision, and contracting of civil engineering and architectural works in Japan. The company undertakes shrines, temples, and cultural properties, as well as government building, office building, education, research, culture, commerce, distribution, production, medical care, welfare, public health, living space, and environmental improvement. It also involved in the sawmilling and woodworking activities; manufacturing, processing, and selling of civil engineering and construction materials; owing, selling, leasing, trading, and management of real estate properties; non-life insurance agency; and brokerage services.
